svg.aria-label: Rana Sheraz Ahmad - genomics terminal session
svg.text: rana_sheraz_ahmad # Bioinformatics Research Associate, SBASSE, LUMS
sheraz@lums:~$ fastqc *.fq.gz && multiqc . && fastp -i R1.fq.gz -I R2.fq.gz -o t1.fq.gz -O t2.fq.gz
sheraz@lums:~$ bwa-mem2 mem -R '@RG\tID:S1\tSM:S1' hg38.fa t1.fq.gz t2.fq.gz | samtools sort -o S1.bam
sheraz@lums:~$ gatk MarkDuplicates -I S1.bam -O S1.md.bam -M S1.metrics.txt --CREATE_INDEX true
sheraz@lums:~$ gatk HaplotypeCaller -R hg38.fa -I S1.md.bam -O S1.g.vcf.gz -ERC GVCF
sheraz@lums:~$ gatk GenomicsDBImport --sample-name-map gvcf.map --genomicsdb-workspace-path db -L chr20
sheraz@lums:~$ gatk GenotypeGVCFs -R hg38.fa -V gendb://db -D dbsnp.vcf.gz -O cohort.vcf.gz
sheraz@lums:~$ bcftools view -m2 -M2 -v snps -i 'QUAL>30' -Oz -W -o snps.vcf.gz cohort.vcf.gz
sheraz@lums:~$ bcftools view -H -r chr20:12014800-12016000 snps.vcf.gz | cut -f1-5
sheraz@lums:~$ plink2 --vcf snps.vcf.gz --pheno ocd.pheno --covar covar.txt --glm hide-covar --out ocd
sheraz@lums:~$ Rscript manhattan_qq.R ocd.OCD.glm.logistic.hybrid # qqman: Manhattan + QQ plots
